limitations: Four development, seven old comparison and three grocery public receipts are small previously-seen convenience samples with AI-only labels.
No actual PriceCraft-user holdout, so production replacement is not eligible.
Grammar validity and bounded repetition do not establish recognition accuracy; record all field budgets and cap failures.
Unchanged preprocessing scales each full image to the published encoder canvas; long-image legibility remains an unresolved hypothesis, not a tested tiling fix.
Legacy flag preserves generation options only; both profiles require complete menu-only receipt output.
First attempt and its initial scores are preserved under donut-decoding-v1; all final model generations were rerun after the review fixes.

decision.production: Keep Groq, pending a frozen actual-receipt benchmark showing better extraction.
decision.training: No training or weights changed; these are generation and output-validation repairs.
decision.next: Investigate long-image legibility/segmentation and product-vs-header errors using development data; retain public challenge families outside training.
